data.message: I commit to 18 tons as an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: will you choose 18? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, avoiding collapse this month, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Other catches require recalculation; intentions aren't binding or proven long-run optimal.
